propositions: Jira-specific probe code (REST URL construction, basic-auth GET, status-name classification) lives in core inbound_probe.py and blocks second-vendor implementation
The neutral vocabulary (ProbeBranch, ProbeResult, ProbeConfigError) and Jira mechanics must be split: vocabulary stays at package root, mechanics move to adapters/jira/probe.py
A runtime_checkable SupportsAbsenceProbe capability Protocol with probe_remote method must be added to _backend.py, implemented by JiraBackend
run_differs.py must route probe dispatch through the backend capability; backends without SupportsAbsenceProbe degrade to ProbeResult(UNREACHABLE)
inbound_probe.py must contain zero adapters.jira imports and no vendor REST code after refactor, enforced by AST gate in test_backend_neutrality.py
Probe classification behavior for all Jira branches (200+resolved, 200+filtered, 404/410/403, 5xx/401/timeout, missing env) must remain byte-identical after migration
